about: The prayer speaks of saints in the plural even when it is used on one saint’s feast. It joins remembrance of their merits with a request to experience their protection.

seg.tr: Lord, we pray that Your saints may bring us joy everywhere, so that, as we recall their merits, we may experience their protection. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,

a.g: who lives and reigns with You

ex.w001: Although the prayer can be used on one saint’s feast, the Latin speaks of saints in the plural.
ex.w005: The request is that the saints bring joy to the praying community.
ex.w010: The merits belong to the saints whose protection we ask to experience.
ex.w031: The word “God” refers to the Son, who lives and reigns with the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit.
